packageRules.description: The release linux job is pinned to ubuntu-24.04 on purpose: the ubuntu-26.04 image's glibc 2.43 made every binary it linked refuse to start on Ubuntu 24.04 / Mint 22.x (#98), and the workflow's 'Enforce glibc floor' step (GLIBC_FLOOR=2.39) fails the build if this drifts. Runner bumps require an explicit compat decision, so Renovate must not propose them.
